Welcome to Dee’s Daily! 

I’m Deanna, a Pilates instructor, Medical Qi Gong practitioner and Registered Canine Massage Therapist based in Toronto. My professional work centres on helping people and dogs move and feel better, but I’ve come to see that our well-being is shaped by much more than movement alone.

To me, wellness is less about perfect habits and more about wholeness - recognizing how movement, home, food, animals, relationships and enjoyment all contribute to how we live and move through the world. 

Here you’ll find Pilates and Qi Gong, canine massage and mobility tips, recipes, cleaning and lower-tox home ideas, seasonal projects and everyday life in between - without the expectation of doing any of it perfectly.

Dee’s Daily is part of Deanna Miconi Wellness. Subscribe and come along! 🔔
